question: Can one exact paired gate/up FP8 consumer reduce launch and activation traffic enough to create a stackable endpoint gain while preserving the real Gemma MLP computation?

immutable_identity.workload: 32 requests, concurrency 32, 4214 prompt tokens and 358 completion tokens per request, 117728 fresh plus 17120 cached prompt tokens

single_candidate.name: paired_gate_up_exact_fp8_consumer
required_semantics: consume the exact real gate and up E4M3 weights and scales
share the input activation quantization/read across both projections
preserve BF16 gate activation, multiply, output layout, and downstream down projection
fall back safely for unsupported shapes
required_measurements: exact decode and observed prefill shapes
relative L2, cosine, maximum error, nonfinite and saturation counts
candidate path proof, launch count, registers, spills, shared memory, and only causal counters
forbidden_changes: weight, scale, cache, sampling, or workload identities

promotion_gate.quality: All exact-shape numerical gates must pass before endpoint promotion; endpoint requires 32/32 sane rows and exact prompt/cache accounting.
promotion_gate.terminal_on_failure: Close this paired-consumer mechanism after the single causal test; do not tune adjacent schedules.
